name: kootenay-browser
description: Color-managed review browser — declare the grade gamma, see the intended image.

scripts.assets: mkdir -p dist/ui dist/probe && cp src/ui/*.html src/ui/*.css dist/ui/ && cp src/probe/*.html dist/probe/ && cp -R src/probe/assets dist/probe/ && cp -R src/probe/corrections dist/probe/
scripts.install-app: npm run package && rm -rf "/Applications/Kootenay Browser.app" && cp -R "out/Kootenay Browser-darwin-arm64/Kootenay Browser.app" /Applications/ && echo "Installed to /Applications/Kootenay Browser.app"
